versions.content: If for a dataElement to be received a ReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRange = saturate is provided, a range check shall be implemented in the receiving component. If the value is out of bounds, the value actually received shall be set to the lower respectively the upper limit. If the value of the received dataElement is out of bounds and a Nonqueue- dReceiverComSpec with handleOutOfRangeStatus = indicate is provided, the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE . In case of a composite datatype each composite element whose actual value is out of bounds shall be saturated. If the handleOutOfRangeStatus attribute is set to indicate , the return value of the RTE shall be RTE_E_OUT_OF_RANGE , if any of the composite elements is out of bounds.
